title: Teams sign-in fails for the whole Leeds office
scenario: A vendor incident shows up late: a synthetic probe says all is well, the health page is clear and then shows an incident, a status banner is only hearsay, and one person's it works now is contradicted by another's still failing.

events.title: Teams sign-in failing, Leeds
events.text: Teams sign-in fails for our whole Leeds office since about 10:30 UTC, 120 people. Weirdly it worked for me at 10:50 for a minute and then failed again. The error is connection timed out.

events.title: Alert from the customer probe
events.text: ALERT (customer synthetic probe): sign-in probe Leeds, success rate 100 percent over the last 15 minutes. Probe host: dc1-probe-02.

events.title: Re: Teams sign-in failing, Leeds
events.text: Hello, thank you. Please send me the names of three failing users and the UTC moment of one failure each. And is that probe running inside the Leeds office network, or somewhere else?

events.title: Re: Teams sign-in failing, Leeds
events.text: Users: g.ahmed 10:34 UTC, t.clarke 10:52 UTC, f.patel 11:05 UTC. The probe runs from our datacentre, not from the Leeds office.

events.title: Sign-in log lookup
events.text: Entra sign-in logs for the three users: no failure rows at those times.

events.title: Service health
events.text: Service health at 12:10 UTC: Teams and sign-in show no open incident.

events.title: Re: Teams sign-in failing, Leeds
events.text: The office manager says the Microsoft status page showed a red banner for Teams around 11:30 and then it disappeared. We have no screenshot.

events.title: Service health, second look
events.text: Service health at 13:30 UTC: Microsoft has posted an incident for Teams and sign-in connectivity, start time 10:25 UTC, impact: some users may be unable to sign in or may see intermittent timeouts.

events.title: Re: Teams sign-in failing, Leeds
events.text: I am in Leeds and it is still failing for me at 13:35 UTC, the same timeout. I do not think it works for everybody.

events.title: It is an incident
events.text: Microsoft confirms the incident that started at 10:25 UTC and says a mitigation is rolling out; users may still see timeouts for a while. There is nothing for you to change. I will write again at 15:00 UTC, or sooner when it is resolved.

events.title: Confirmation
events.text: Microsoft marked the incident resolved at 15:10 UTC. I checked three Leeds users at 15:20 UTC and all of them signed in. Closing the case.
